messages_hand_global_idx.name: messages_hand_global_idx
messages_hand_global_idx.where: "messages"."hand_id" is not null and "messages"."group_id" is null

messages_content.name: messages_content
messages_content.value: "messages"."texto" is not null or "messages"."mano" is not null or "messages"."estadisticas" is not null

profiles_nombre_len.name: profiles_nombre_len
profiles_nombre_len.value: "profiles"."nombre" is null or length(trim("profiles"."nombre")) between 2 and 20
